cards.name: Pegshell
cards.rule: The first hit it takes each round deals 0

cards.name: Treasury Sentinel
cards.rule: End of round: heals 5% of max HP

cards.name: Bondback Tortoise
cards.rule: Takes 90% of incoming damage

cards.name: Ledger Owl
cards.rule: Once per match, while active, the first enemy crit against any ally becomes a normal hit

cards.name: Vault Golem
cards.rule: +10% DEF each time an ally faints, stacking to +30%

cards.name: Mint Sprite
cards.rule: Once per match, end of round below 30% HP: swaps with the first living bench card, keeping its HP

cards.name: Coupon Crab
cards.rule: Reflects 10% of damage taken to the attacker

cards.name: Reserve Bison
cards.rule: Once per match, a lethal hit leaves it at 1 HP

cards.name: Aurum Lynx
cards.rule: +10% ATK in round 1

cards.name: Yield Heron
cards.rule: End of each round it is active: +2 ATK, up to +10

cards.name: Gilded Ram
cards.rule: Its first attack of the match ignores 50% of target DEF

cards.name: Rebalance Fox
cards.rule: Once per match, end of round: the lowest-HP ally active card below 40% swaps with the first living bench card

cards.name: Collateral Bear
cards.rule: +15% DEF while below 50% HP

cards.name: Bullion Beetle
cards.rule: End of round: heals 3% of max HP

cards.name: Basis Kestrel
cards.rule: Uses the highest enemy active SPD if higher than its own

cards.name: Spread Serpent
cards.rule: Its hits set target DEF -10% for 2 rounds; refreshes, does not stack

cards.name: Leverage Raptor
cards.rule: Each attack: 60% chance of 2x damage; otherwise 0.5x and it takes 10% of its max HP

cards.name: Liquidation Wolf
cards.rule: After its hit, a target below 20% HP faints

cards.name: Funding Wasp
cards.rule: Heals 30% of damage it deals

cards.name: Loop Kraken
cards.rule: Attacks twice at 60% damage, each with its own variance and crit rolls

cards.name: Perp Panther
cards.rule: +500 bps crit at the end of each round it is active, up to +2500

cards.name: Ape Comet
cards.rule: Always acts first in the round

cards.name: Basis Mantis
cards.rule: 20% chance to dodge an incoming hit

cards.name: Halving Hydra
cards.rule: Its hits halve the target's next heal
